title: Rate Earned Over the Closing Period of a Security Deposit Refund
content:
**Rule on the interest rate earned within a refund, for the closing period.**

The closing period runs from the period end of the latest interest credit on the Security Deposit, or from the fully secured date when none has been credited, to the refund date. Its days are counted from its start date to the refund date, the start date not counted. Its closing rate is the Commission rate of the calendar year of the refund date: 3.85% (0.0385) for 2024, 4.02% (0.0402) for 2025 and 4.17% (0.0417) for 2026 onward. The time the deposit has been held is counted in whole months from its fully secured date to the refund date.

1. Where the deposit has been held at least the kind's minimum holding months on the refund date, and the closing period began in an earlier calendar year than the refund date with an opening rate that differs from its closing rate, its days up to and including 31 December of that earlier year earn the opening rate and its days from 1 January of the refund date's year on earn the closing rate, each as days over 365.
2. Where the deposit has been held fewer than the kind's minimum holding months on the refund date, the closing period earns no interest.
3. Otherwise the days of the closing period earn the closing rate as days over 365.

## Minimum holding months by kind

| Security Deposit kind | Minimum holding months |
|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 6 |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | 6 |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | 6 |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 6 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 6 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 6 |

## Cases (hypothetical deposits)

**Held 9 months; closing period 12 May 2025 to 12 February 2026; opening rate 4.02%, closing rate 4.17%.** Clause 1 applies: 233 days (13 May to 31 December 2025) at 4.02% and 43 days (1 January to 12 February 2026) at 4.17%, each over 365: 1115.97 percentage-days over 365, about 3.0575% for the period.

**Held 4 months.** Clause 2 applies: the closing period earns no interest.

**Held 18 months; closing period 1 March 2026 to 30 June 2026.** One calendar year, so clause 3 applies: 121 days over 365 at 4.17%.
